sample_data.method: In-memory singleton store initialization and Supabase PostgreSQL migration
sample_data.reset_instructions: Visit http://localhost:3000/dashboard/seed-data to view and inspect all 8 benchmark edge cases, or execute 'npm run migrate:supabase' to re-sync the full 60-student dataset to Supabase.

problem_solving_method: Engineered a pure deterministic calculation engine using arbitrary-precision arithmetic (Decimal.js) with 100% test-driven compliance against all official rules (R-10 through R-30). Wrapped with an explainable audit trace generator, automated pre-publication checking lists, real-time score editor, marks sheet ingestion diagnostics, and cohort failure analytics.

R-11.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:evaluateSubjectMark (Dual component pass constraint: Theory >= 25/75 AND Practical >= 8/25)

R-12.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:evaluateSubjectMark ('AB' token preserved; compulsory absent yields GP 0.00 F; optional absent contributes 0 bonus)

R-13.evidence: src/engine/calculator.ts:calculateStudentGPA (Compulsory fail overrides overall GPA to 0.00 F; Raw GPA uncapped calculation and capped GPA at 5.00)

R-20.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:calculateOptionalBonus (Bonus = max(0, GP_opt - 2.0) over 6 compulsory subjects with 6.0 divisor)

R-21.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:mapTotalMarkToGrade (Standard 0-100 marks to GP/Letter grade scale)

R-29.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:classifyCheckingFlags & src/app/dashboard/checking-lists/page.tsx (Optional List GP <= 2.0 / AB, Practical Fail List < 8, Absent List AB)

R-30.evidence: src/engine/trace.ts & src/components/results/TraceDrawer.tsx (Per-student immutable step-by-step calculation audit trace)

R-IMPORT.evidence: src/engine/marks-importer.ts & src/app/dashboard/import/page.tsx (CSV/TSV/JSON ingestion with exact row-by-row rejection diagnostics)

R-ANALYTICS.evidence: src/app/api/v1/analytics/route.ts & src/app/dashboard/analytics/page.tsx (Pass rate, grade distribution, most failed subject analysis with root causes)

team_members.major_contribution: End-to-end architecture, deterministic GPA calculation engine, checking list workflow, marks sheet importer, analytics dashboard, and Supabase integration.

major_design_decisions: Used Decimal.js for all arithmetic operations to eliminate IEEE-754 floating-point rounding errors in grade point summations.
Decoupled calculation engine into pure TypeScript functions with 100% test coverage for instant verification.
Implemented automated pre-publication checking lists with multi-list support and teacher verification sign-off tracking.
Integrated row-by-row marks sheet validator that highlights exact rejection reasons and suggested fixes for malformed data.
known_limitations: Currently supports single-session examinations; multi-term cumulative weighted aggregation is planned for the next release roadmap.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Architecture modeling, test-driven validation, UI component design, and rule verification.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Executed 26 automated unit tests covering all 8 benchmark edge cases and verified calculations via live interactive audit traces.
